gameRules:
The Alias game is a fast-paced word-guessing party game. The goal is to get your team to guess as many words as possible by explaining them without saying the word itself.

Basic Rules of Alias

1. Teams

• Players split into teams of 2 or more.
• Team members take turns being the explainer.

2. Objective

• The explainer describes a word so their teammates can guess it.
• Each correct guess earns 1 point.
• The team with the most points at the end wins.

3. Explaining Words

The explainer:

• Can talk freely, use synonyms, descriptions, examples, or associations.
• Cannot:
   • Say the word itself or any part of it
   • Use rhymes
   • Translate the word into another language
   • Use gestures or sounds (unless house rules allow it)

Example: If the word is "apple", you might say:
"A fruit that can be red or green and keeps doctors away."

4. Time Limit

• Each round is time-limited (usually 60 seconds).
• The explainer keeps going until time runs out.

5. Passing & Penalties

• You may skip a word if it's too hard.
• Skipped or broken-rule words usually subtract 1 point.

6. End of Turn

• When time is up, the round ends immediately.
• Any unfinished word does not count.

7. Winning the Game

• The game ends when a team reaches a target score (e.g., 30 points).

Common Variations

• No passing allowed
• Gestures allowed
• Kids version
